gaps.sentence: She beat three hundred ___ (COMPETE) for the title.
gaps.hint: plural noun: the people she beat
gaps.explanation: 'Three hundred competitors' — plural noun for the people taking part.

gaps.sentence: This shop offers a wide ___ (SELECT) of cheeses.
gaps.explanation: 'A selection of' = a range of items to choose from.

gaps.sentence: The team celebrated a quick ___ (SOLVE) to the crisis.
gaps.explanation: 'A solution to the crisis' — the noun.

gaps.sentence: Their ___ (FRIEND) goes back to their university days.
gaps.explanation: 'Friendship' is the relationship between friends; 'friendliness' is a manner.
'Her persistence' — the quality noun from persistent.

gaps.sentence: The dogs’ astonishing ___ (LOYAL) to their owners is well documented.
gaps.explanation: 'Astonishing loyalty' — the quality noun is required after the adjective.

gaps.sentence: The mountain road has been ___ (WIDE) to cope with coach traffic.
gaps.explanation: Passive 'has been widened' — the verb form meaning made wider.
